column1: # TRANSLATION layer (prior, NOT corpus-cited): each row maps a bare /
# underscored lemma to a Russian gloss that translates the deck's
# English gloss. build_deck.py appends ` / <ru>` to a card ONLY when
# its English gloss has no Cyrillic yet (so hand-overrides that already
# `#` lines are comments. Keep glosses terse and sense-aligned with the
# English; preserve sense order. MWUs use `_` (e.g. ոչ_ոք).
# Populated 2026-06-03 from the top-300 English-only cards (user card
# review). Coverage tracked by check_missing_russian in validate_deck.py.
